title: Mobile release planning
turns: Okay, let's start. Nihal, can you give us the status of the iOS build?
Sure. The build passed review yesterday. We are only waiting on the new screenshots.
Muhammed, where are we with the screenshots?
I have four of the six done. The dark mode ones are left. I need one more day.
Then Hafeed can send them to me tomorrow and I will upload them in the evening.
That works. What about the crash on older iPhones?
I traced it to the keyboard extension. It runs out of memory when the dictionary is large.
Could we load the dictionary lazily instead of all at once?
That is what I was thinking. I can try it today and see if the memory drops.
Good. Let's decide that the release waits until the crash fix is in. No release with a known crash.
Agreed. Should we move the release date then?
Yes, move it from Monday to Wednesday. I will tell the support team.
Same here. I'll finish the screenshots tomorrow.
Thanks both. Let's meet again on Tuesday to confirm.
decisions: The release waits for the keyboard crash fix
The release moves from Monday to Wednesday

actions.text: Finish the dark mode screenshots and send them to Nihal
Try loading the dictionary lazily to fix the memory crash
Tell the support team the release moved to Wednesday
